args.query: select id, business, niche, area, rating, website, email, phone, facebook, contact, score, heat, stage, hook, next_step, you_action, mockup_url, mockup_requested, call_script, dm_text, deal_value, first_contact, last_contact, touches, next_followup from ops.leads where stage not in ('Opted out', 'Lost') order by score desc, id

leads.description: Every open lead (not lost or opted out) with website check, contact info, contact history, pitch hook, stage and deal value. Reads ops.leads in the Side Quest Client Portal database.

args.query: select id, ord, name, role, status, schedule, next_run, last_run, last_result, hands_to, uses_ai from ops.agents where id in ('scout','planner','finder','detective','sales','builder','site','content') order by ord

agents.description: The live crew: each agent's job, schedule, last run and latest result, and whether it uses Claude. Reads ops.agents.

args.query: select id, at, agent, action from ops.activity order by at desc, id desc limit 60
select id, date, platforms, pillar, format, hook, idea, caption, cta, asset, status from ops.posts where date >= current_date - 7 order by date
select id, type, item, who, agent, priority from ops.todos order by priority, type, id

weekly.title: Weekly numbers
weekly.description: Leads found, emails sent, mockups made, replies and deals won per week for the last 8 weeks, Central time. Reads the ops.weekly_stats view (built on ops.leads and ops.lead_events).

args.query: select week, found, contacted, mockups, replied, won, won_value from ops.weekly_stats order by week

builds.title: Client site builds
builds.description: One row per won client the Site Builder is building a site for, with status, preview link and launch checklist. Reads ops.builds.

args.query: select id, lead_id, business, package, status, preview_url, live_domain, checklist, you_action, updated_at from ops.builds order by status = 'Launched', created_at desc

dossiers.title: Detective case files
dossiers.description: What the Detective found on each lead from public business sources: owner as the business publishes it, history, services, photos, reviews, rivals and pitch angles. Reads ops.dossiers.

args.query: select lead_id, owner_name, owner_source, founded, services, service_area, hours, story, credentials, brand_colors, logo_url, photos::text as photos, reviews, social, booking, competitors, pitch_angles, sources::text as sources, confidence, researched_at from ops.dossiers order by researched_at desc
